name: ACC Ltd
about: ACC Limited (incorporated in 1936), a member of the Adani Group, is principally engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling of Cement and Ready Mix Concrete.  The Company has manufacturing facilities across India and caters mainly to the domestic market. [1] [2]

flags.text: Debtor days rose from 14 to 54 in three years: customers are taking longer to pay
Only 51% of the last five years' profit arrived as operating cash
Free cash flow negative in 3 of the last 5 years

business.what: Ambuja Cements Limited is a major cement manufacturer and part of the Adani portfolio. It produces and sells cement and ready-mix concrete, focusing on value-led growth through premium products, operational efficiency, and strategic capacity expansion.

segments.name: Cement
segments.comment: Trade volumes grew 8.6% year-on-year, with increased focus on premium and blended products.

segments.name: Ready-mix concrete
segments.comment: Achieved 1.07 million cubic meters volume, growing 19% year-on-year with 125 plants.

kpis.name: Premium product share of trade sales

ledger.promise: Total cement capacity of 155 million tons by March 2028
ledger.quote: These initiatives will provide a clear and capital -efficient pathway to reach our aim of hitting 155 million tons by March of '28
ledger.actual: Guidance pushed back in Q2 FY27 call to FY30 for 155 MTPA, with FY29 targeted at 149 MTPA.

ledger.promise: Cost per ton of INR 3,650 by March 2028
ledger.quote: Our narrative on reaching INR3,650 per ton of cost by March '28 continues.
ledger.actual: Guidance revised upwards in Q2 FY27 call to INR 4,000 per ton for FY28.

ledger.promise: Cost per ton of INR 3,800 by March 2027
ledger.quote: our journey to achieve INR3,800 per ton of cost by March '27; INR3,650 by March '28, that conviction and confidence continues.
ledger.actual: FY27 operating cost target raised to INR 4,250 per ton in Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 calls.

ledger.promise: Annual capex of INR 10,000 crores in FY26
ledger.quote: And therefore, this capex, when I indicate to you, it also will be a factor of how the existing assets also spans out... ballpark, INR10,000-odd crores
ledger.actual: FY26 cash flow from investing was positive Rs 1,273 crore with CWIP standing at Rs 2,227 crore, well below target.

ledger.promise: EBITDA per ton of INR 1,250 to INR 1,300 in FY27
ledger.quote: the target is to hit EBITDA, which is almost closer to INR1,250 to INR1,300 a ton and then gradually move towards INR1,500 per ton.
ledger.actual: EBITDA margin dropped to 7.9% in Q1 FY27 (Rs 457 crore) and 7.0% in Q2 FY27 (Rs 401 crore).

ledger.promise: Double-digit volume growth over next 2-3 years
ledger.quote: See, volume will be growing double digit. While my base will keep increasing, but double digit is what we are expecting.
ledger.actual: FY27 volume growth guidance cut to 8% in Q4 FY26; management noted H1 FY27 volume was flattish.

ledger.promise: Warisaliganj commissioning scheduled for Q1 FY27
ledger.quote: the Warisaliganj commissioning is now scheduled for first quarter of '27. So there is a delay of 3 months in Warisaliganj
ledger.actual: Commissioning timeline pushed to Q3 FY27 / second half of FY27 in Q2 FY27 call.

ledger.promise: Annual capex of INR 6,000 to INR 6,500 crores in FY27
ledger.quote: So for FY '27, we are keeping an estimate of almost INR6,000 crores to INR6,500 crores.
ledger.actual: Guidance revised up to INR 7,500 crores per year in Q2 FY27 call.

ledger.promise: Installed capacity of 119 million tons by end of FY27
ledger.quote: We are expecting to hit capacity of almost 119 million tonnes by end of FY '27.
ledger.actual: Target timeline is end of FY27 (March 2027).

current_guidance.quote: With these measures, we are on track to achieve our FY27 cost target of INR4,250 per metric ton.
In addition, the 2.4 million tons capacity at Warisaliganj in Bihar will be commissioned in second half of FY27.

current_guidance.target: 149 MTPA by FY29 and 155 MTPA by FY30
current_guidance.quote: So you're right, by FY29, 149 million metric tons and by FY '30, 155 million metric tons.
So yes, so almost like INR7,500 crores per year for these investments.
It was FY28, INR4,000 actually. So at FY28, you will be hitting 149 MTPA, and that is how the guidance is.

credibility.label: low
credibility.summary: Management has consistently revised timelines and targets, pushing back capacity completion dates, raising cost targets, and missing FY26 capex guidance. Meanwhile, reported operating profitability and cash flows have deteriorated sharply over successive quarters.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management targeted significant cost reductions (INR 250/ton reduction per year) to drive margin expansion.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated EBITDA margin dropped from 18.7% in Q3 FY25 to 7.9% in Q1 FY27 and 7.0% in Q2 FY27, with Q2 FY27 EBITDA falling to Rs 401 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management guided to an annual capex spend of ballpark INR 10,000-odd crores in FY26 to improve KPIs.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 cash flow from investing was positive at +Rs 1,273 crore and CWIP was Rs 2,227 crore, indicating actual asset creation fell far short of guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management anticipated double-digit volume growth long-term and 8% volume growth in FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 FY27 revenue declined 4.6% QoQ to Rs 5,808 crore and Q2 FY27 revenue fell further to Rs 5,689 crore, while management conceded H1 FY27 volume was flattish.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management indicated that execution issues were resolved and execution would proceed in a much sharper manner.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Operating cash flow deteriorated from +Rs 1,711 crore in FY25 to -Rs 1,364 crore in FY26, and PAT dropped from Rs 1,119 crore in Q2 FY26 to Rs 93 crore in Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Long-term capacity expansion pipeline targets 155 MTPA by FY30.
bull.evidence: Management outlined plans for 30 million tons expansion requiring INR 14,500 crores total capital outlay.

bull.point: Full-year revenue expanded significantly over recent years.
bull.evidence: Annual consolidated revenue increased from Rs 19,959 crore in FY24 to Rs 25,962 crore in FY26.
Borrowings stood at Rs 513 crore in FY27 compared to a capital expenditure program.

bear.point: Severe contraction in operating margins and net profit.
bear.evidence: EBITDA margin fell from 18.7% in Q3 FY25 to 7.0% in Q2 FY27, while PAT dropped from Rs 1,119 crore in Q2 FY26 to Rs 93 crore in Q2 FY27.

bear.point: Operating cash flows turned negative in FY26.
bear.evidence: Cash flow from operations fell from +Rs 1,711 crore in FY25 to -Rs 1,364 crore in FY26.

bear.point: Repeated walking back of key operational and financial targets.
bear.evidence: 155 MTPA completion date pushed from March 2028 to FY30, FY28 cost target diluted from Rs 3,650/ton to Rs 4,000/ton, and Warisaliganj commissioning delayed multiple times.
